description: Strips emails, phone numbers, card numbers, SINs and IPv4s. Runs locally, no model. Returns { text, counts }: the redacted text with [EMAIL]-style placeholders and a count per kind (email, card, sin, phone, ip). Price: 1 credit (1 credit = 1 CAD cent) per successful call; input that does not match the schema is rejected before billing.
